hotspotSheet.message: Anyone nearby with the frecu's code joins your network without looking for it. It's stored only on your phone.

guide.sameWifi: We're already on the same Wi-Fi

network.heading: Frecu creates the network
network.message: Your phone will be the group's antenna. No internet, and none of your data.
network.readyMessage: Now give your room a name and a code.

steps(interface=HotspotStep).rest: The first time, Android asks for the nearby devices permission.

steps(interface=HotspotStep).lead: Open your room and show the QR.
steps(interface=HotspotStep).rest: It already carries the network and its password: your group joins with a single scan.

steps(interface=HotspotStep).lead: Closing the room turns the network off.
steps(interface=HotspotStep).rest: The next one gets a new name and a new password.

network.label: Room network
network.keyInQr: The password travels in the QR
network.hotspotOnMessage: Android doesn't allow another network at the same time. Turn it off and try again, or keep it: your group joins your hotspot as usual.
network.nearbyDeniedTitle: The nearby devices permission is missing.
network.nearbyDeniedMessage: Android requires it to create the network.
network.locationDeniedTitle: The precise location permission is missing.
network.locationDeniedMessage: On Android 12 or earlier, Android requires it to create the network.
network.locationOffMessage: On Android 12 or earlier, Android requires it to create the network.
network.failedMessage: Try again in a few seconds or use your hotspot.
network.unsupportedTitle: This phone can't create the network.
network.unsupportedMessage: It needs Android 8 or later. Use your hotspot.

newRoom.title: New room
newRoom.name: Room name

newRoom.codeHelpInternet: The link and the QR already include it: share them only with your group.

internet.title: Allow internet
internet.on: People far away can also join with the link. Uses mobile data.
internet.off: Only people on your network can join.

network.lostMessage: Your group got disconnected. Create it again and show the QR again.
network.failedMessage: Turn your hotspot off if it's on and try again.

internet.title: Scan or share

invite.title: Scan to join
invite.message: From Frecu › Scan. The QR already includes the code.

island.waiting: On air · waiting for your group

welcome.title: Your whole group on the same frecu.
